cinder_bloom.desc: Aura radius +25%. A primary kill of a burning enemy leaves a non-stacking 1s cinder patch while aura runs.
cinder_bloom.name: Cinder Bloom

ember_aura.desc: Transform Ashen Ward into a paid toggle: 10 mana to start, 3 per 0.5s pulse, radius 2.5.
ember_aura.name: Ember Aura

siphon_embers.desc: Heal 2% of actual aura damage, capped at 3% max life in a rolling second. No overkill or secondary healing.
siphon_embers.name: Siphon Embers

steady_flame.desc: Aura upkeep -5% per rank. Damage and pulse timing are unchanged.
steady_flame.name: Steady Flame

ward_temper.desc: Ward absorption +10% per rank. After transformation, ranks 2 and 3 each add 5% aura pulse damage.
ward_temper.name: Tempered Ward

point_rule: Mage: one point every five levels, 20 through 60
